title: Core: AS2 Error class and custom errors
description: Verify AS2 Error class compiles: new Error('msg'), e.message, e.name. Subclassing: class MyError extends Error { function MyError(m:String) { super(m); this.name = 'MyError'; } }. throw new MyError('oops') in a try/catch. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/errorclass.test.ts.
